newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PresMed to buy part of Aukland firm.
newsitem.headline: PresMed to buy part of Aukland firm.

text.p: PresMed Investments Ltd said on Thursday an agreement had been reached in principle in terms of which it would acuiqre a strategic minority interest in HospiPlan -- a wholly owned subsidiary of Aukland Investments.

The deal, which is subject to due diligence, was expected to result in benefits accruing to both Aukland and Presmed and represented a further step by the combined group in establishing a strategically positioned country-wide network of private hospitals and day clinics, the companies said.

The transaction would take the form of a capital injection into Aukland and HospiPlan, the proceeds of which would be used to fund the expansion of Aukland's current businesses, facilitate further acquisitions of private hospital interests and supplement the Aukland and HospiPlan's working capital resources.
A detailed announcement would be published after a formal agreement had been concluded.
Until then, Aukland shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
